sources.title: gte-small: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: Yes. The model loads via transformers and sentence-transformers, both of which support standard PyTorch fine-tuning workflows. Use contrastive loss functions and triplet-like training data to adapt the model to your domain or task-specific semantic relationships. Q: What input format does gte-small expect? A: Plain text strings in English only.

sources.title: ANEForge
sources.snippet: ANEForge is a direct, CoreML-free Python frontend for the Apple Neural Engine: it lowers a tensor graph into one fused Espresso e5rt program and dispatches it to ANE silicon from an ordinary user process, with no CoreML and no special entitlement. These docs are the software manual - how to install, call, train, target, and extend the frontend.
